Wants low-friction hosted API onboarding but may evaluate Dedicated later if latency/throughput needs increase. Call highlights (2026-03-02):
- Head of Product: "We need a deterministic JSON schema and per-field confidence scores so our UI can auto-map and flag uncertain values."
- Concern: hallucinated KB citations when model suggests KB links. Wants guardrails and citation provenance.
- POC: provide 500-ticket sample eval (F1 on intent, hallucination rate on KB citations).

POC asks: trial API key + recommended prompt templates, example structured output schemas, and guidance for streaming and early-abort heuristics. SE recommended enabling structured output enforcement and a fallback policy for empty/low-confidence fields.

Decision criteria: summary accuracy, deterministic structured fields, cost per 1k tickets, easy self-serve signup and docs.
